title: The Episode About the Disappearance of Banda Singh

blocks.text: The marriage tradition unfolds by linking Banda to the Sodhi line, using miraculous validation to persuade a reluctant household and secure a match.
Children and descendants are then named, and the poet closes by emphasizing that he writes only what he heard from elders and others.
The Sodhi line is the central anchor because lineage, not battle, governs the logic of this page.
